benchmarks.name: CamBench
benchmarks.verified_fact: README describes CamBench_Real (real Java apps with manually labeled usages), CamBench_Cap (synthetic capability cases), and CamBench_Cov (heuristic coverage).
benchmarks.use: Primary benchmark source for Java crypto API detection and capability coverage.
benchmarks.caution: Older benchmark; not an enterprise CBOM benchmark and not a direct measure of ECDAT quantum-risk quality.

benchmarks.name: CryptoAPI-Bench
benchmarks.verified_fact: README states it contains 16 cryptographic vulnerabilities with secure and insecure Java snippets.
benchmarks.use: Regression and misuse benchmark for Java rules.
benchmarks.caution: Focuses on crypto API misuse, not full CBOM discovery.

benchmarks.name: Python Crypto Misuses in the Wild
benchmarks.verified_fact: README states the study analyzed the top 895 Python GitHub repositories by stars and dependencies, with published misuse findings.
benchmarks.use: Large real-world Python misuse corpus and methodology reference.
benchmarks.caution: Study data is from an older snapshot; use for benchmarking methodology and historical comparison, not current ecosystem prevalence.

benchmarks.name: PQC Signature Benchmarks in C
benchmarks.verified_fact: README describes keygen/sign/verify benchmarks for PQ signatures via liboqs and traditional signatures via OpenSSL, with metadata and CSV output.
benchmarks.use: Migration trade-off measurements; repeat locally on the actual demo machine before using numbers.
benchmarks.caution: README example numbers are not ECDAT measurements and must not be copied into results.

benchmarks.name: RSL PQC Benchmarks
benchmarks.verified_fact: README labels v0.0 as methodology + scaffolding and says no measurement data has been published yet.
benchmarks.use: Methodology inspiration only until a measured release exists.
benchmarks.caution: Do not cite it as an empirical benchmark dataset.
